rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for foolishness expressed as an impractical course of action or a thoughtless act.

example.english: Don't commit this kind of folly again—you left the whole family homeless just to save a little money.
example.traditional: 你唔好再做呢啲蠢事喇，為咗慳少少錢搞到成家人冇地方住。

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fanciful building constructed mainly for decoration rather than practical use.

example.english: The folly in the garden was built purely for decoration and has no practical use.
example.traditional: 花園入面嗰座裝飾性建築純粹係為咗觀賞，冇任何實際用途。
